children.text: The AI scene has progressed so fast I can't keep up... Even if you try the cutting-edge stuff today, something different will probably be out by next week. It's like catching a cold, sleeping it off, and waking up in a different world (?).

最近
いや、別に話についていけないわけではなく、どちらかというと変化が予測可能なので、「ああ、まあそうなるよね」ってなってわざわざ自分から追っかけるのをやめた感じ。なのかな

data.description: LLMs, image generation, and other advances are happening so fast that keeping up has become a hassle.
